findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

A tea pot style container in the back room for Starbucks is observed with remaining food debris while in storage.  This indicates that it was not completely cleaned prior to storage. The PIC was shown and moved the item to the three part sink for soaking and re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are completely cleaned prior to storage in the facility.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

A tub containing whipped canister lids and other food contact items is observed with brown debris in the bottom of the container in the Starbucks back-stock area. The PIC was shown and had the container, and items inside, cleaned during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact items are protected from contamination while in storage and prior to use.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Debris is observed under the counters along the back wall of the prep area for Starbucks. The PIC was notified and instructed to have the area cleaned often enough so as to prevent accumulation. Ensure the facility is cleaned often enough so as to remain clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

The wall to the left of the ice bin in the Starbucks prep area is observed with crevices that prevent effective cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to seal prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas near moisture/food are sealed to allow for a smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

Numerous consumed and partially consumed drinks are found on one set of shelves in the online order walk-in cooler where customer foods are stored. The PIC was shown and discarded the items during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. He also pointed out the shelving unit at the other end of the room designated for this purpose. They are instructed to review the storage of employee foods with employees to prevent this situation in the future.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 


On arrival the hand sinks in the Starbucks storage area and the ambient room are blocked. The PIC was consulted and moved the obstructions to correct the violations. Ensure that the hand sinks are maintained easily accessible at all times.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Wooden stir sticks at the Starbucks counter are stored in a plastic container that needs cleaning. This was discussed with the PIC. The stirrers were discarded and the container cleaned to correct. Ensure that any food contact items are protected from contamination prior to use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair. 

The hand sink in the ambient room is observed to be leaking. The fixture also appears to be loose in its bracket. The PIC was shown/consulted and instructed to repair the fixture prior to the follow up. The normal follow up timeframe lands on a weekend, due to this the follow up will be conducted on Monday.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Multiple locations in the facility are observed soiled during this inspection: 1) the floor around the pipes under the right side of the counter in the Starbucks area; 2) the wall behind where cases of water are stored; 3) the fan covers in the walk-in and; 4) the trash can shelving in the Starbucks area. All locations were shown to and discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to clean them. The facility should be swept, mopped and wiped often enough to be maintained in a clean state.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Wooden stir sticks at the Starbucks counter are stored in a plastic container that needs cleaning. This was discussed with the PIC. The stirrers were discarded and the container cleaned to correct. Ensure that any food contact items are protected from contamination prior to use.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-402.11: (A) EQUIPMENT not EASILY MOVABLE shall be installed to allow cleaning access, spaced a distance of one thirty-second inch or SEALED. (B) Counter-mounted EQUIPMENT not EASILY MOVABLE shall be installed to allow cleaning by SEAL or elevated legs. 

Shelves along the right wall in the walk in freezer are too low to the floor and do not allow for cleaning. At the front of the walk in it appears to be only 2-3 inches of clearance with a significant amount of debris underneath. At the back of the cooler the shelves are practically sitting on the floor. Adjust the shelves up so that effective cleaning can be conducted. 4-6 inches are suggested.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

The mop in the Starbucks back room is stored on the floor in the mop sink. Education conducted and it was moved to its hanger to facilitate drying.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

1) The floor in the walk in cooler and under the shelves in the walk in freezer are in need of detail sweeping into the corners and along the edges. It also needs mopped throughout the observable areas in the cooler. Clean often enough to prevent soilage from accumulating. It was suggested to cycle moving sections of stock and cleaning throughout the week to allow for all areas to be cleaned regularly. 2) The bottom shelves in the walk in cooler are in need of cleaning. Clean often enough to prevent soil accumulation.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
STARBUCKS: Three opened gallons of milk observed without date marking. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Milks were likely opened yesterday, and were labeled with dates accordingly. Ensure any opened containers remaining in the facility more than 24 hours are labeled with the date opened.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1. (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Ambient thermometer in the customer display cooler over the yogurt display was observed to read 100+ F when cooler was functioning properly at approx. 40F. Calibrate or replace thermometer so that it accurately reflects the ambient temperature of the cold holding unit.
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed using improper handwashing technique (applying soap, quickly rinsing hands, and using hands to turn faucet off). CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC and provided education. Review handwashing procedures with all food-handling staff.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
CAFE: No paper towels provided at the back handwashing sink. CORRECTED— Paper towels provided. Ensure always available at handwashing sink.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]
